discussion.body: Act 13. Rails. Deep Maze Fissure, the dungeon the Act 7 cataclysm opened. Longer than the Act 7 mouth. Floors use the six aspects against the party (Mist veil, Earth pin, Water pull, Fire leak, Life blight, Light lie) then Nyxara. Single ending per FEAT-037. Cael and Liraen live. Suggestive romance beat on the Light-scarred south horizon after the seal, not a kiss cutscene. Then stop.
